feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 May 2026 10:55pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 14 May 2026 at 10:55pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure is centred north of the Azores, with low pressure south of Greenland and over Scandinavia.


##Wind##

North or northwest force 5 or 6 in the west of the area, but 4 or 5 in the east. Then decreasing 4 or 5 in all waters on Friday morning, but falling variable 2 or 3 in the southwest of the area during the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling mainly slight by Friday afternoon.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, soon becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in any showers at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, backing west or west-northwest 3 or 4 overnight into Saturday, then south or southwest during the day, but occasionally 5 in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain and drizzle spreading from the west on Saturday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.
